mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id AS authorId, a.category_id AS categoryId, a.status, a.version, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, u.nickname AS authorName, c.name AS categoryName FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
